text:
incident-bot: Pager: SRE P0 — Private VPC cross-region routing errors detected. Affected: private-vpc customers with ILB fanout between eu-west1 <-> us-central1. Trigger: route propagation failures + increased TCP RSTs. Pagerduty: SRE-Oncall.

sanjay patel: ack — I'm on it. I'm seeing elevated route update errors in our control plane logs, and the ILB healthcheck metrics spiking to 502/504s for some backends. starting trace capture now.

maria chen: taking over in 2m for coordination. @rachel can you pull the customer impact list and notify CS? I'll run quick route diagnostics and try a scoped reapply.

rachel o'neil: pulling impacted customer list. preliminary: cust-olive, cust-sparrow, small batch of sandbox tenants in eu-west1 peered to us-central1. Notified CS for cust-olive and cust-sparrow (email + slack).

sanjay patel: commands I'm running:
```
# check forwarding rules + backend health in both regions
gcloud compute forwarding-rules list --filter="region:(eu-west1 us-central1)" --format="table(name,region,IPAddress)"
gcloud compute backend-services get-health my-ilb-backend --global
```
seeing backend health flapping only when route updates are pushed. Also seeing repeated 429s from GCP control-plane API in our route-propagation worker logs: `HTTP 429: Quota exceeded`

tomas ivanov: adding here — Datadog shows a concurrent spike in our control-plane API error rate starting ~1903456000. Cloud Monitoring shows controlplane.googleapis.com request_count high with many 429s.

gcp-support: GCP support update: we are seeing elevated control-plane API throttle events affecting compute route propagation in the affected regions. Engineers have flagged a transient autoscaling/rollout on the control plane causing delayed route fanout. We're escalating now; ETA for mitigation unknown but working a lightweight control-plane retry patch.

maria chen: interim mitigation plan: (1) pause bulk route pushes from our control-plane workers, (2) reapply critical customer routes in small batches (1-2 per minute) to avoid further throttles, (3) enable regional fallback for affected ILBs so traffic routes locally until cross-region routes stabilize.

sanjay patel: doing batch reapply now. command: 
```
# reapply single route example
gcloud compute routes create r-cust-olive-eu-us --destination-range=10.40.0.0/20 --next-hop-ilb=projects/PROJ/regions/eu-west1/forwardingRules/my-ilb --priority=1000
```
reapplied 2 routes so far, monitoring.

rachel o'neil: CS update sent to custodians: short note + mitigation steps, told them we may see intermittent timeouts for up to 2 hours, offered to open support ticket if they see ongoing errors. :white_check_mark:

tomas ivanov: note on observability — some metric ingestion for ILB forwarding-rule health is delayed (Cloud Monitoring -> Datadog sync lag). correlate using raw logs from Stackdriver export instead of aggregated metrics for now.

gcp-support: update 1903457000: We've rolled a hotfix to reduce control-plane write contention for route propagation in eu-west1/us-central1. We're still monitoring; control-plane API error rate dropping but not back to baseline. Recommend slowly retrying route pushes.

maria chen: confirmed reduced 429s in our worker logs. continuing slow reapply. handoff plan: I'll own the next 2 hours and then hand to @sanjay if needed. keeping the page open.

sanjay patel: noted and thanks. tracking customer impact: preliminary numbers — ~30-40% of traffic for affected private-vpc ILBs experienced errors between 1903455600-1903456800. could be higher for real-time inference flows.

rachel o'neil: opened incident ticket and notified account reps for cust-olive / cust-sparrow. CS asked for estimated RCA ETA and SLA impact. Provided preliminary impact window and said RCA after containment.

maria chen: additional mitigation: for customers with strict SLAs we enabled regional pinning (temporary config) via Redwood Console to force regional-only ingress until cross-region routes stabilize. This reduces availability for cross-region clients but restores local traffic. Applied to cust-sparrow.

gcp-support: update 1903457600: control-plane API error rate near baseline; propagation latencies reduced. We recommend keeping slow batch pace for 30 more minutes and then resume normal pacing.

tomas ivanov: monitoring shows ILB backend health normalized for reapplied routes. Still scanning for any residual flapping.

maria chen: prepping handoff notes for next on-call: summary, commands run, list of reapplied routes, customers pinned regionally, contact with GCP case #CASE-2026-427. handing off to sanjay at 1903458123.

sanjay patel: taking over. I'll keep the page open for another hour and start the post-incident customer impact doc. thanks all for quick responses :wave: :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Incident P0 acknowledged and in mitigation. Log bookmark: https://redwood-internal/incident/1903456789 (internal)

maria chen: final note before handoff — root cause appears to be GCP control-plane write throttling during a localized rollout that caused delayed route fanout across regions for our Private VPC ILBs. Immediate mitigations: batch route reapplies, enable regional pinning for critical tenants, escalate with GCP. Next steps: RCA draft, evaluate control-plane retry/backoff and rate-limiting in our route propagation worker, and add automated slow-retry mode to avoid future tight bursts.

rachel o'neil: adding customer comms follow-up to the incident doc. Will request crediting for affected windows once RCA is final.

sanjay patel: closing paging loop. If anything regresses, re-open page.
